d: CEN-SWSFP-40-TAA 40 Port Managed Switch with Redundant Power Supply Slot, TAA Compliant

specs.label: Ethernet ports
specs.value: (32) 10 Gigabit Base-X SFP+; (8) 25 Gigabit Base-X SFP28

specs.label: Management
specs.value: Out-of-band; IT Web GUI (main); HTTPs, CLI, Telnet, SSH; SNMP, MIBs, RSPAN; Radius users, TACACS+

specs.label: IPv4/IPv6 ACL and QoS
specs.value: Ingress/egress; 1 Kbps shaping, time-based; Single rate policing

specs.label: IPv4/IPv6 Multicast Filtering
specs.value: Automated IGMP between switches; IGMPv3 MLDv2 snooping, proxy ASM and SSM; IGMPv1, v2 querier (compatible with v3); Control packet flooding

specs.label: IPv4/IPv6 Policing and Convergence
specs.value: Auto-VoIP; Policy-based routing; LLDP-MED; IEEE 1588 PTPv2

specs.label: IPv4/IPv6 Authentication Security
specs.value: Successive tiering (DOT1X, MAB, Captive portal); DHCP snooping; Dynamic ARP inspection; IP source guard

specs.label: IPv4/IPv6 Static Routing
specs.value: Port, subnet, VLAN routing; Multicast static routes; DHCPv4 server; DHCP relay; Stateful DHCPv6 Server

specs.label: IPv4/IPv6 Dynamic Routing
specs.value: IPv4: RIP; IPv4/IPv6: PIM-SM, PIM-DM, SSM

specs.label: Spanning Tree Green Ethernet
specs.value: STP, MTP, RSTP; PV(R)STP; BPDU/STRG; EEE 802.3az
